notes: LÖVE port of Blobby Volley 2: 2D volleyball with blob physics, local play, scripted AI bots, and multiple rule sets (classic, tennis, blitz, and others). CLEAN: GPL-2.0; gameplay graphics (BMP) and SFX (WAV) are from the original GPL Blobby Volley, credited in README to Silvio Mummert (graphics) and Daniel Skoraszewsky (programming); bitmap font sheet font.bmp (no TTF/OTF); no EXE/DLL/LFS. ~2.3M. Claim #3829.
